paras: Application: Nissan R35 GT-R – VR38DETT Part Type: Triple catch can kit (PCV + dual CCV) with Fluid Lock Part Number: 20-0566-FL

Radium Engineering catch can kits collect oil and water condensation from the crankcase gases before they reach the intake, reducing oil build-up in the intake tract, intercooler, throttle body and intake manifold. Cleaner inlet air helps maintain effective octane and can improve performance, and the closed system keeps oil vapour out of the cabin.
hl: Triple Can System: PCV can plus dual CCV cans for complete crankcase ventilation
Fluid Lock: Patented design prevents overfilling and traps collected fluid
2-Step Baffling: Integrated condenser for effective oil separation
O-Ring Sealed Dipsticks: Check fluid level without removing the can
Pressure Sealed: No inline check valve needed – connects directly to the intake manifold
Direct Fitment: Vehicle-specific brackets, no drilling required
ft: Radium Engineering Triple Catch Can Kit for Nissan R35 GT-R, Fluid Lock
